description: Spec 031: one unfinished item. A tool-less session on a local model reads only the facts pkpipe knows about the item (state, processing status, the fixed failure reason, owner retries, classifier evidence of a hold, the notable events of its history; never page, note or image text) and writes its situation, the cause and the next step in short sentences. If the session fails, the fixed-sentence fallback built from the codes is used, so the table never blocks.
